name: benchmark-climatefever
description: benchmark-climatefever evaluates systems on fact-checking and verification of climate-related claims by assessing whether claims are supported or refuted by evidence. It is aimed at measuring models' ability to retrieve relevant evidence and produce correct verification labels for climate/science claims. The benchmark focuses on domain-specific factual correctness rather than general QA fluency.
reputation: A specialized dataset in the climate fact-checking niche that is less widely used than general fact-verification benchmarks but valuable for domain-specific evaluation.
